text: I purchased 4, 2 smaller, 2 large.  First the color - I chose the taupe gray.  It is exactly as described - browner than gray - but not at all like the photo.  The photo looks much more gray. text: I’ve put together more than my fair share of ‘assembly required’ products in my life and I say these rolling under bed storage boxes are among the best in terms of craftsmanship and simplistic assembly. The wheels are already installed on the support bars and then those wheel bars along with center support rods are all attached to a pair of small wooden pieces for shipping. Not only does this insure all pieces of the products are accounted for, but it also keeps all the small pieces from rattling around inside the box. The fabric is an upholstery type and feels very durable, and the ‘walls’ are reinforced with some type of lightweight MDF instead of cardboard making them very sturdy. The wheels spin a full 360 so you don’t have to maneuver like your trying to backup a trailer on a hitch, too! This product is very impressive, especially for the price. Highly recommended!

title: Nice, soft, furry throw that is a bit overpriced for what it is
text:
This is a nice throw that arrives in a shrink-wrapped package (see photo) but expands as shown (see photos). It is fuzzy on one side and silky on the other. The backing is not sewn to the throw except at the edges. This means it does not always fold well and stay aligned with the front during use. That is typical of any throw made this way and is typical of others I own.

The throw has a very soft feel but I did expect the furry part to be more plush with a longer pile, especially since the price was listed at $35.99 when I purchased it and is now $29.99. The current price is about $10 more than I would expect to spend and certainly more than I've spent in the past for similar throws with shorter fibers. Nevertheless, this is really nice and my cats definitely approve. I'm certainly not disappointed with my purchase, especially since a 50% discount was applied at checkout when it was listed at the higher price.

I would not consider this giftable unless it is removed from the shrink-wrapped plastic wrapping.

title: It can completely revive your old mattress..!!!
text:
Wow! So impressed as this can single-handedly change a nights sleep! This can take an older mattress that has lost its support and create new life by using it placed directly on top. A great alternative to replacing an entire mattress.. TBH, i’d never have known the difference as I felt like I was sleeping on a brand new bed set!

I find this ideal for those younger kiddo growing years.. after the toddler/twin size, since we all know they move through growth phases like weeds! We’ve actually used x1 full size mattress with our kids before they reach puberty and get their own larger bedroom set. By the time it came to our last one.. things felt a little unsupported and worn in! The struggles of being the youngest!! Ha! not anymore… I’ve now got my college aged kiddo asking for this mattress topper for her apartment- go figure!! It truly feels hotel firm with a moldable gel that cradles around the pressure on top while providing support in a nicely balanced way- pretty much like voodoo!

Love this has a built in 1” wide strap to hold topper in place on all x4 corners and goes deep to create a secure fit. BUT my favorite is the protective cover and sleeve that zips around topper keeping it safe from the yuck that mattresses can acquire over time and it’s machine washable- AmAzInG! The sleeve/cover is a soft fabric with a impressed print that actually is a bit grabby so it holds onto sheets that are placed on top.. All the attention to detail like this make it so user friendly!

Without hesitation I would recommend to anyone needing to sustain life in a mattress… Or, looking to improve comfort and support. This is a solid item that offers a fantastic night sleep! Hoping this info can help make your decision- sweet dreams everyone.

title: Perfect for a guest room-
text:
Loving this is non-specific and a very universal look in this quilted bed set. Used in our guest room it holds a nice neutral and unisex vibe- nothing feels overly feminine/masculine which I appreciate in this guest type setting! (No ruffles or frills needed to achieve a polished/finished look!)

Material is lightweight in warmth creating the goldilocks amount of comfort.. nothing too heavy or constricting while sleeping. You can always add a layer for warmth but can’t take one away from the top blanket- so, its ideal for all x4 seasons.

In any guest bed- I find it key to pair fresh top bedding with a quality set of sheets.. (and a full filled pillow insert is a must!) Ha! this quilt is like the icing on top! Add a soft throw at the foot of the bed.. and a deliciously inviting fabric for an accent pillow- the combo provides guests with a stay that’s all about the comfort!! I’ve had 2 guests already and both raved about sleeping comfort-What more could I ask for in an endorsement..?!!

Material is soft and finished nicely. I find straight seams, no loose threads- and I appreciate the striped pattern this offers. Airy blue allows bedding to look of almost a crisp and clean white solid.. but, not being so lends that tiny bit of forgiveness from any blemish or marking left behind!

At a price point of $40 for Queen- I don’t hesitate to recommend! Easily dressed up/down one can make this their own.. Hoping this info helps your decision- stay safe everyone!

title: Best new kitchen gadget... EVER! Beginner model!
text:
Welcome to the greatest thing to happen in 2020..!! If, you want to add a kitchen Vice to help aid cooking capabilities- you may be looking at it right here.. I’m just impressed by this appliance so much! An air fryer is to this decade.. What a Cuisinart was to the 80’s- Or, kitchenAid mixers to the 50’s..!! It is one of those have/have not luxuries- but, I see these becoming a staple in kitchens as this has the ability to take root! This has staying power to outlast any fad bc, whatever you’re air frying- it is done with ease, far less cleanup then, the oil alternative making it a healthy option and best yet, producing commercial like results every time.. pretty much like witchcraft!

After using: I found out an air fryer doesn’t cut down the cooking time all that much.. (and this was my belief!) It DOES cut down on needed prep/cleanup by eliminating what would be cooked in oils.. But, hands down the reason to use if for healthy and quality end results EVERY time.. I’m still so shook!!!

As for machine, I chose midnight blue and it’s gorgeous! An appliance this size is a commitment. It’s not small- of course, it can be stored out of sight.. but, might be a hassle to get in/out everytime you want to use. I lack storage capacity in my pantry for this and couldn’t give up prime counter real estate- so, I’ve gone and ordered a ($30) kitchen cart- Not sure how long it’ll last aesthetically for me.. (I say this to show how much I’m willing to commit to have this right ready!! And share an idea if you lack space like like I do!) consider size and storage.. Especially, if wanting to use often- make sure to find the room! for the record: I chose 3.5Qt. for my family of 4 (they do have 5Qt. option as well!)

Controls are just 2 turn knobs heat/time.. that is it! All numbers are well marked, on/off light display helps know when in use. This has printed “standards atop the fryer” for items most used- which may be confused as button but, they’re not!! See photo included (This does NOT overwhelm with switches that rival the inside of a cockpit- whew!!) This has a solid, steady base for total peace of mind.. Instruction manual is straight forward- except how to turn on! (It’s done by turning timer btw!!) total disclosure, I first tried with one who’s used this before, taking away apprehension the 1st time around! After watching- I see how unnecessary it was to be intimidated by the air frying method.. Ha! maybe it’s due to the size?! Either way, no need to fear this.. it is just that easy.

We’ve made cajun chicken nuggets, chicken strips, homemade sweet potato fries, zuch. slices + shred parm. topping, store bought potatoes O’Brien, waffle fries and all have turned out- Restaurant worthy!! (Note: I lightly brushed zucchini with garlic olive oil- Ha! its been my fav. so far, hands down!!) cleanup is a breeze and insert is dishwasher safe- Now.. I am a true believer! I hope this info can help your decision.. feel free to let me know!

*I 100% recommend a flip chart or, help guide just to help make using.. a smooth and easy option!!

title: Easy to set up.
text:
Words cannot express how excited I was to get this bed. A year ago we got our first memory foam mattress and I was over the moon (or under, since I was happily sleeping in its light). But when we were getting a *king*-size bed, I was never happier.
I thought this was the same brand as one we had set up last year, but it was not. I also set up one by this brand earlier this week, but all in all the three platform beds I've assembled have been the same. The shipping box comes with the headboard and everything else inside. It was a bit of a pain hauling it up three flights of stairs to our apartment, but we pulled through! I was afraid when opening it because some parts of the box had been torn through, but thankfully there weren't any rips or anything.

Everything you need to assemble the bed is included. You really need only one hex wrench (I forget the exact size); it comes with one, but I used my own anyway. There are a few spare screws, but nothing else is spared. I'm not sure who makes this bed; the included instruction sheet had Modern Essentials instead of Zinus, so Zinus could very well just be the supplier. Dunno.

Anyway, once everything was set up we were good to go. I assembled it by myself in about an hour. The only complaint I have, however, is that, like the same platform bed we have but without the headboard, this bed's center peg doesn't sit on the floor all the way. There's about a centimeter gap or so. When you lie on it it obviously goes down and touches the floor, but with...um...certain movement...you're going to have that center bed bang on the floor repeatedly. Hopefully you don't have neighbors right under your bedroom!

The headboard isn't very high, but it's fine for us since we stash stuff on top, like phones or water bottles, and that makes them more easily accessible.

Besides that uneven center peg, it's a great bed so far, and is very easy to assemble.

text:
Oh boy...are these sheets ever dangerous! Dangerous because you are NOT going to want to climb out of bed in the morning after sleeping on these!

I washed the set prior to use as I always do. Had absolutely no issues. (Washed on cold/gentle cycle, tumble dry on low. Its recommended the sheets be removed as soon as the drying cycle is finished to decrease wrinkles and avoid using fabric softener/dryer balls) They fit our king size mattress like a glove. Easy to put on, easy to remove. My goodness, are they ever soft and airy. I love that I don't get overheated with these sheets as I tend to with others. On the flip side, my husband is always cold due to BP medication but these sheets keep him nice and warm. They really are a perfect balance....not too hot, not too cold.

I almost didn't order this set. I'm pretty sold on Jersey cotton sheets but I figured it was time to try something new and I am SO very glad that I did. You'll sleep like a baby on these and won't want to climb out of bed in the morning. Definitely worthy of gift giving!

title: My Life Is A Bit Easier Thanks to SimpArte 360 Containers!
text:
These containers have made my life easier. They truly have. They hold a lot and the lids are tight so I don't worry that the contents will spoil or turn stale quickly. The 360 degree view of the container is my absolute favorite part of the container. No more trying to guess what the contents of the container holds, I can see it immediately. I received a wonderful bonus lid where I can pour the contents from rather than opening the entire lid. I happen to have flour in one of the containers. Using the pour lid, I can easily pour flour into a measuring cup rather than trying to scoop out the amount of flour I need using a measuring cup, which always ends up making a huge mess!

I need more of these and will order them. They're a great size, the lids fit beautifully and they stack nicely. I'm very much looking forward to a more organized kitchen than I previously had! I do have some name brand as well as store brand plastic storage containers. These work far better than the others I have and I fully intend on phasing the others out and replacing my kitchen with ALL SimpArte containers!
